summary: Join our Quality Assurance in Social Protection Monitoring Training Course to master essential skills for effective program evaluation and improvement.
lede: Quality assurance in social protection monitoring helps programme teams check whether records and reports provide reliable evidence. For monitoring officers, programme managers, registry analysts and evaluation specialists, it covers validating registry records, reconciling payments, and reviewing case and grievance evidence to identify gaps and plan corrective actions.
audienceIntro: This social protection monitoring course is designed for professionals who review programme evidence, manage delivery controls, or report social assistance and social insurance performance. It suits intermediate to advanced practitioners who already work with administrative data, field monitoring, beneficiary records, or evaluation processes.
prerequisites: You should have practical experience in social protection programme delivery, monitoring, evaluation, administrative data, social registries, payments, or grievance systems. Familiarity with spreadsheets and basic indicator calculations will help, but coding is not required. Advanced concepts such as AI-assisted anomaly screening and automated validation are taught at an operational application level, not a software engineering or production-deployment level.
